# Visualizing blackouts in Houston, Texas after the 2021 winter storms

## Load Libraries

```{r}
# Initialize libraries
library(terra)
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap)
library(sf)
library(stars)
```

## Load data
```{r}
# Load satelite data
data_dir <- here::here("data/VNP46A1/")


band_files <- list.files(data_dir,
                         pattern = "\\.tif$",
                         full.names = TRUE,
                         ignore.case = TRUE) |>
  sort()

landsat <- rast(band_files)
names(landsat) <- c("blue", "green", "red", "NIR", "SWIR1", "SWIR2")

```
